timing_boundary: Complete four-clip worker including setup, solve, import, analysis/export, bank assembly, readback, original validation, compressed arrays and compact storage. Excludes process startup, Python bootstrap and post-run reference comparison. Bootstrap+worker times also recorded. Stage timers overlap.
limitations: Four representative clips, not a full corpus or concurrency benchmark.
Baseline/add-on-only measurements show appreciable variability; use medians and reported ranges.
Larger savings require explicit caller integration; regular full-bank UI behavior is unchanged.
No CUDA acceleration or new runtime dependencies. Profiled timings are not throughput measurements.
Retained cache charge is bounded; transient reads/caller-held snapshots and total process RSS are not covered.
